contract_freeze: source-control history records this exact contract before any KT100 V2 campaign

period2.branch_identity: anchor-relative A/B; first complete cycle is A

normalization.global_species_inventory: abs(delta of each global species inventory) / total system gas mass at start of the later-indexed compared cycle
normalization.cycle_mass_increment: absolute difference of cycle increments / total gas mass at start of the later-indexed compared cycle
normalization.p7_burned_species_increment: absolute difference of burned_produced mass / total gas mass at start of the later-indexed compared cycle
normalization.heat_increment: absolute difference of cycle P7 heat / total gas energy at start of the later-indexed compared cycle
normalization.duct_species: absolute difference of each species mass fraction, each normalized by that cell total mass
normalization.duct_velocity: absolute difference of velocity divided by each compared local sound speed
normalization.raw_conservative_vectors: persist and compare exactly for restart/replay; not a convergence observable
normalization.invalid_inputs: INVALID; no epsilon or stale PASS substitution

observable_vector: cylinder and crankcase terminal mass, total energy, pressure, temperature
each intake, transfer and exhaust duct cell mass, total energy, pressure, temperature, velocity/sound-speed, and four species mass fractions
global four-species inventories normalized by total system mass
cycle fresh delivery by transfer and total
cycle P7 burned_produced mass increment and heat increment; all other P7 ledger fields are audit-only
threshold_rationale: Numeric tolerances reuse the existing accepted E13-R1 limits: 0.005 for work/pressure-type observables and 0.002 for inventory/transport observables. The harness applies them to explicitly listed physical terminal observables and does not claim E13 conformance.

cycle_relative_event_adapter.geometry_callback_angle_offset_deg: inverse scheduler offset; preserve configured physical crank geometry
cycle_relative_event_adapter.cycle_boundary_and_checkpoint_angles: apply the same scheduler offset; rebase each completed physical revolution to scheduler [30+offset,390+offset] while preserving conservative and species state exactly and carrying global elapsed time separately
